name: pulumi-cats-vs-dogs-ts-migration
instr:
The cats-versus-dogs `dev` platform runs from Terraform in `/workspace/terraform` (local modules `network`, `platform`, `services` and `observability`; `terraform.tfstate` is production). The platform team already bulk-imported every production resource into stack `dev` of the Pulumi project `cats-vs-dogs` in `/workspace/pulumi`, but its entry point `index.ts` declares nothing, so a preview would delete everything. We need the TypeScript program, without changing anything deployed.

Each module call is one `pulumi.ComponentResource` under the stack, named after the module and typed `cats:modules:Network`, `cats:modules:Platform`, `cats:modules:Services` or `cats:modules:Observability`. Each Terraform resource instance is exactly one `@pulumi/aws` resource of the type the stack holds, under its module's component, named after the Terraform resource plus `-<key>` for `for_each` instances (`nat-us-east-1a`); nothing else is declared. Each variable in `variables.tf` is a same-named config key (`cats-vs-dogs:project`, ...) holding its value as plain YAML (integers, strings, booleans, mappings with Terraform's attribute names), and unset keys take the Terraform default. For any values Terraform and AWS accept, `pulumi preview` plans the same creates, updates, replacements, deletions and settings as `terraform plan`, and reverts drift as Terraform would.
